title: Strengthen the length-22 seven-label census with a union-support budget; exclude the (9,9) split (no new kappa)
body:
## Summary

Adds one proved necessary condition to the corrected seven-label word census of #2973 and uses it to extend the length-22 split domain of open PR [#3731](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3731). Produced by Nick Petalas with AI assistance. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

**Scope, up front:** finite word census inside PR943's singleton prefix-walk model. No kappa, supplier, tariff, certificate, frozen-input or selected-frontier change. `f(7)` remains `22 <= f(7) <= 24`; this PR does not decide length 22. It excludes one more split and measures floors for the rest.

## What is established

1. **A strictly stronger even-side budget, with a proof.** The merged independent census [#3005](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3005) proves that a universal completion must satisfy

   ```
   |U| + C(S,2) + C(T,2) - C(e,2) - C(o,2) >= 2^(n-1) - 1,
   U = supp EE union supp OO.
   ```

   This package ports exactly that bound into the fast corrected C engine of #2973 (plus the `L<=22` gate already recorded in #3731). Because `|U| <= |supp EE| + |supp OO|`, it **dominates** the predecessor's even excess budget `a+b <= B0`, which charges an overlapping mask twice. The complete engine delta is the committed zero-context [`engine/DELTA.diff`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/w8-1018b-l22-union-census/research/f7-l22-union-census/engine/DELTA.diff) against the pinned `corrected_census.c` (`sha256 265ead91...`). The pinned bytes are unchanged; `--no-union-budget` restores the predecessor's even test.

2. **Soundness evidence.** The predecessor's raw-product brute-force cross-check (`validation/check_corrected_c.py`, unmodified) passes with the union engine: 164 comparisons over all small splits and all four budget modes, including positive universal counts, with cap and fail-closed controls. A union-only run (both older budgets disabled) also matches the brute-force universal counts. The six recorded L20/L18 receipts replay complete and zero-hit. Node counts there are intentionally not compared: the union budget removes nodes by design, and the pinned receipts are untouched.

3. **A new length-22 finite split exclusion: `(9,9)`.**

   | Split | Nodes | Outcome |
   |---|---:|---|
   | `(11,7)` | 8,620,043 | complete, zero hits (control for #3731) |
   | `(10,8)` | 239,946,434 | complete, zero hits (control; #3731: 597,933,297) |
   | `(11,8)` | 1,017,687,439 | complete, zero hits (control; #3731: 1,349,702,650) |
   | `(9,9)` | 388,563,293 | complete, zero hits → **new finite split exclusion** |
   | `(10,9)` | ≥ 6.7976e9 | one shard capped at 3e9; floor only |
   | `(10,10)` | ≥ 1.43517e10 | six shards capped at 1.5e9; floor only |
   | `(11,9)` | ≥ 8.1284e9 | one shard capped at 1.5e9; floor only |
   | `(11,10)` | ≥ 7.5000e9 | five shards capped at 1.5e9; floor only |
   | `(11,11)` | ≥ 6.0000e9 | four shards capped at 1.5e9; floor only |

   Every split is the fifteen disjoint restricted-growth length-four prefix shards. `RESULT.json` records per-shard receipts; a split is an exclusion only when all fifteen shards exit complete with zero hits and no cap. The five floors are sharded-node sums with capped shards counted at their caps; they are not exclusions.

   **Domain after this PR.** #3731 left six splits: `{(9,9),(10,9),(10,10),(11,9),(11,10),(11,11)}`. Excluding `(9,9)` leaves five. The union budget also cuts the `(10,8)` tree by 2.49x and the `(11,8)` tree by 1.33x at the same stated scope.

4. **Negative answer to #3731's pair-identity question.** The exact identity `2 sum_x A_x B_x = sum_y r_y^2 - s*t` gives a leaf **lower** bound on a partial quantity that is monotone **increasing**, so it cannot reject a partial state. A usable prune needs a leaf upper bound; the union-support bound is one. This is recorded rather than implemented as an unsound prune.

## Verification

```sh
# Registered checks (each under the 600 s per-command margin; local timings below):
python3.12 -I -B research/f7-l22-union-census/verify.py --skip-probe      # 37 s
python3.12 -I -B research/f7-l22-union-census/verify.py --probe-split 11,7  # 0.4 s
python3.12 -I -B research/f7-l22-union-census/verify.py --probe-split 10,8  # 6.6 s
python3.12 -I -B research/f7-l22-union-census/verify.py --probe-split 11,8  # 35 s
python3.12 -I -B research/f7-l22-union-census/verify.py --probe-split 9,9   # 10 s

# Local only, not run by CI: all completed splits.
python3.12 -I -B research/f7-l22-union-census/verify.py --probe-all
```

- **CI replay: passed.** `plan` pass (2m6s) and `replay (research/f7-l22-union-census)` pass (6m30s) on Actions run [39169381951](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39169381951), job `117799522004`, which ran all five registered checks under CPython 3.12 in CI. This is the authoritative certification of the four exclusions and the validation stages.
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/f7-l22-union-census outcome=completed` also locally, with all five registered checks.
- `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` at `e09a08b5f85e648be373bece1b6ea1265d5ea8fa`, base `20ecf2891` (canonical main, priority revision 6), with `--check-source-history`.
- Interpreter: CPython 3.12.15 at `~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12`; Apple arm64, 18 cores, Apple clang.
- Sharded node sums are deterministic and compared exactly; timing fields are excluded from every equality check. A sharded sum exceeds an unsharded run by duplicated shared prefix nodes (51 when every shard survives to depth four), so sharded totals are compared only with sharded totals.

## Overlap and credit

- Overlap re-checked at submission against open PRs and discussions; #3731 is the direct predecessor probe and #3005 is the merged source of the union bound. No other in-flight L22 union-support run was found.
- **Nicholas Stone** (#2973 corrected engine, budgets and split theory); **Aaron Wang** (PR2542/PR2634 word model); **Ross Richardson** (PR943 prefix-walk model); **Nick Petalas** (#3005 union-support bound; PR #3731 L22 domain and budget). This package: produced by Nick Petalas with AI assistance.
- Frozen predecessor packages and `upstream/` are unchanged.

## Open next questions

1. Finish the five remaining splits: each capped shard needs a larger cap, or a further proved completion bound. `(10,9)` has one shard above 3e9; `(10,10)` has six above 1.5e9.
2. Independently replay the `(9,9)` exclusion with a separately implemented engine; the #3005 C++ census at `L=22` is the natural candidate.
3. Can the pair identity be turned into a leaf *upper* bound other than the shared-support union bound? That is the only direction that can prune.
